profiles.method: Cosine similarity of positive card enrichment above the same commander baseline
profiles.interpretation: Candidate overlapping tag groups; no deck intersections or build shares inferred.

model_selection.criterion: Smallest eligible K within one standard error of the best held-out reconstruction score plus (K-1)/usable decks
model_selection.reason: Selected 1 package(s), the simplest supported count within one standard error of the best complexity-adjusted held-out reconstruction among 1–8. This is an exploratory heuristic, not proof of the number of strategies.
model_selection.validation_note: Three seeded 80/20 deck splits; fixed full-sample vocabulary and IDF. Reconstruction, not independent predictive validation.

deck_analysis.method: IDF-weighted binary nonland cards; L2-normalized decks; NMF

tag_suggestion_rule.note: All profiles above both heuristic similarity floors; no fixed tag count or calibrated tag confidence.

deck_analysis.consistency_note: Matched component cosine across four initializations and three 80% training subsets; not a confidence probability.
deck_analysis.interpretation: Relative package weights, not probabilities or population build shares. Source tags are unused during fitting; labels are profile-based suggestions.

limits: Tag profile similarity does not measure shared decks or imply compatible strategies.
EDHREC card lists are truncated: omitted cards are unknown, never observed zeros.
Only cards with eligible-deck denominators at least 90% of the page deck count are compared.
Profiles use a fixed 20-deck regularizer and 1 percentage point enrichment floor; these are pilot heuristics.
NMF learns cards without source tags. Automatic package counts are selected conservatively from data-supported candidates; explicit counts are exploratory alternatives.
Package memberships and suggested tag labels are exploratory scores, not probabilities.
Incomplete lists, exact copies and wrong commanders are excluded; near copies can remain.
Sample composition, budget, bracket and deck age may explain packages alongside strategy.
Imported text may contain unrecognized nonbasic lands unless EDHREC lists them as lands.
Results describe the successfully loaded sample, not every deck on EDHREC or its source sites.
